description: One row per (athlete, meet entry) with a recorded 2nd and 3rd deadlift attempt. Built by notebooks/01_data_extraction_and_cleaning.ipynb from the OpenPowerlifting bulk CSV.
label: dl3_failed

roles.id: Row or group identifier. Never a model input.
roles.split: Train/validation/test assignment. Never a model input.
roles.label: Target variable.
roles.decision_input: The value the coach chooses (planned 3rd attempt weight). Model input.
roles.feature: Core feature from report Table 1. Model input.
roles.candidate_feature: Known at decision time but not part of the core feature set (report section 7.3). May be used after a leakage check.
roles.segment_only: Used only for fairness / segment analysis. Never a model input.
roles.metadata: Context for analysis, filtering and drift monitoring. Not a model input by default.

columns.name: record_id
columns.description: Stable pseudonymous row id (hash of athlete, date, meet and attempts).

columns.name: athlete_id
columns.description: Pseudonymous athlete id: first 16 hex chars of SHA-256(salt + OpenPowerlifting Name). Group key for the split.

columns.name: split
columns.description: Athlete-level split, derived deterministically from athlete_id.

columns.name: meet_date
columns.description: Start date of the meet (ISO 8601).

columns.name: meet_year
columns.description: Year of meet_date. Useful for a time-based split and drift monitoring.

columns.name: federation
columns.description: Federation that hosted the meet (OpenPowerlifting code, e.g. USAPL).

columns.name: meet_country
columns.description: Country in which the meet was held.

columns.name: tested
columns.description: 1 if the entry counts as drug-tested, else 0.

columns.name: dl3_weight_kg
columns.description: Weight of the 3rd deadlift attempt (absolute value; the coach's planned weight in the app).

columns.name: dl2_weight_kg
columns.description: Table 1 #1. Weight of the 2nd deadlift attempt.

columns.name: dl2_success
columns.description: Table 1 #2. 1 if the 2nd deadlift attempt was good, 0 if failed.

columns.name: dl3_jump_pct
columns.description: Table 1 #3. (dl3_weight_kg - dl2_weight_kg) / dl2_weight_kg * 100.

columns.name: bodyweight_kg
columns.description: Table 1 #4. Recorded bodyweight at the meet.

columns.name: age_class_group
columns.description: Table 1 #5. IPF-style age group derived from Age, BirthYearClass or AgeClass (see 03-data-preparation.md).

columns.name: equipment
columns.description: Table 1 #6. OpenPowerlifting equipment category.

columns.name: best_squat_kg
columns.description: Table 1 #7. Best successful squat of the same meet.

columns.name: best_bench_kg
columns.description: Table 1 #8. Best successful bench press of the same meet.

columns.name: dl3_jump_kg
columns.description: dl3_weight_kg - dl2_weight_kg.

columns.name: dl1_weight_kg
columns.description: Weight of the 1st deadlift attempt, if recorded.

columns.name: dl1_success
columns.description: 1 if the 1st deadlift attempt was good, 0 if failed, empty if not recorded.

columns.name: dl2_jump_pct
columns.description: (dl2_weight_kg - dl1_weight_kg) / dl1_weight_kg * 100, if the 1st attempt is recorded. Not capped: winsorize before modelling.

columns.name: dl3_to_bodyweight
columns.description: dl3_weight_kg / bodyweight_kg.

columns.name: dl3_to_best_squat
columns.description: dl3_weight_kg / best_squat_kg (flags atypical lifter profiles, report section 7.2). Long tail: injured lifters sometimes squat only the empty bar.

columns.name: age_years
columns.description: Age on meet day if known (x.5 = approximate, see OpenPowerlifting docs).

columns.name: prev_best_deadlift_kg
columns.description: Best successful deadlift of the athlete in any EARLIER meet (strictly before meet_date). Empty for first-timers.

columns.name: prev_meets_count
columns.description: Number of distinct earlier meet dates of the athlete in OpenPowerlifting (any event).

columns.name: sex
columns.description: Sex category of the entry. Fairness analysis only (report section 6.2). NEVER a model input.

columns.name: dl3_failed
columns.description: Label: 1 if the 3rd deadlift attempt was failed (negative value in the source), else 0.
